fullDescription: A warm sand-and-terracotta e-commerce checkout: two-column billing + payment form on cream cards beside a sticky dark order-summary card, with a segmented Card/PayPal toggle and an AA-contrast Pay button.

structured.summary: A warm, premium e-commerce checkout page in a 'sand + terracotta' palette (sand #efe7d8 page, terracotta #c4633f accent, near-black ink #2b251d text) built around a two-column checkout layout: a left billing + payment form and a right sticky dark order-summary card. The form uses soft 12px-radius cream fields on cream cards with a terracotta focus ring, a Card/PayPal segmented toggle, numbered section headers (1 Billing details, 2 Payment method), and a same-as-shipping checkbox. The summary card is a single dark ink surface with product line items, a promo-code row, totals, and a full-width terracotta Pay button. A sticky blurred sand nav, a grain-textured hero strip with breadcrumb + SSL trust pill, and a slim footer frame the page; it reflows cleanly to single column on mobile.

style.description: Warm, tactile, premium-artisanal e-commerce. A low-contrast sand/cream paper system with a single terracotta accent and a near-black ink used both for text and as the one dark surface (the order-summary card). Soft rounded fields and cards (12-16px radius), gentle layered shadows, a faint dot-grain texture on the hero, and hairline sand borders instead of heavy boxes. Inter throughout (400-800) with slightly negative letter-spacing; small uppercase eyebrows on wide tracking. AA-contrast-fixed: the Pay button uses the darker terracotta terradk #a64f30 (not the lighter terra) on white text for accessible contrast.
style.prompt: Design in a warm, premium-artisanal e-commerce style. Palette: sand #efe7d8 (page background), sandlt #f6f1e7 (cards / lightest band), sanddk #e6dcc9 (card border tone), terra #c4633f (primary accent: brand tile, active states, icons, cart badge), terradk #a64f30 (Pay button rest, segment active text, eyebrow), terraxd #8a4127 (Pay button hover), ink #2b251d (primary text + the dark order-summary surface), inkmut #6b6253 (secondary text); white #ffffff for input fields; field rest border #e0d6c2, label color #5a5040, placeholder #7c715d. Borders are the warm sand tones (#e0d6c2 / #e6dcc9) as hairlines. Typography: Inter (400,500,600,700,800) via Google Fonts, font-family Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; antialiased; body letter-spacing -0.011em; font-feature-settings cv11, ss01. Headings are extrabold (font-800) with tight tracking and leading ~1.02; eyebrows are 12px font-700 uppercase tracking 0.22em in terradk; body is 13-16px in inkmut. Shadows are soft and warm-tinted: card 0 1px 2px rgba(43,37,29,.04) + 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(43,37,29,.18); soft 0 1px 2px rgba(43,37,29,.05) + 0 6px 18px -10px rgba(43,37,29,.14); button 0 8px 20px -6px rgba(196,99,63,.5). A faint dot-grain texture (radial-gradient dots, 2.5% ink, 4px tile) sits on the hero strip. Fields focus to a terra border with a 4px rgba(196,99,63,.14) ring. Calm, warm, retail-premium, never loud.

layout_and_structure.description: A standard desktop checkout page at max-width 1180px, vertically stacked: sticky nav, a grain-textured hero strip (breadcrumb + headline + SSL pill), then the checkout body as a two-column grid (left flexible form column, right fixed 380px sticky order-summary), then a slim footer. The right column is sticky on lg and drops below the form on mobile; the two-up name/expiry field rows and the segmented toggle collapse gracefully on small screens.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50), 64px tall, sand/85 background with a backdrop-blur-md and a bottom hairline (border #e0d6c2). Inside a max-w-[1180px] row, justify-between: left = a 32px rounded-lg terracotta tile (shadow-btn) with a white ph:diamonds-four-fill icon and the wordmark 'Atelier' + 'Sand' where 'Sand' is terracotta (17px font-800, tight tracking); center = four nav links (Shop, Collections, Journal, Support) at 14px font-500 inkmut, shown only on md+; right = a 'Secure' text button with a ph:lock-key-fill icon (sm+) and a 36px round white cart button (border #e0d6c2) with a ph:bag-fill icon and a terracotta '3' count badge pinned top-right.

A full-width grain-textured strip (radial dot-grain) with a bottom hairline and a subtle gradient from sandlt to sand. Inside max-w-[1180px], py ~10-14. A breadcrumb row at 12.5px font-500 inkmut: 'Cart' caret 'Checkout' (terracotta font-600, current) caret 'Confirmation', using ph:caret-right-bold separators. Then a flex-wrap row, items-end, justify-between: left = an eyebrow 'ALMOST YOURS' (12px font-700 uppercase tracking 0.22em terradk), a big headline 'Complete your checkout.' (2.4rem up to 3rem, font-800, leading 1.02), and a 15.5px inkmut sub-paragraph (max-w-xl); right = a trust pill (white/70, border #e0d6c2, rounded-full, shadow-soft) with a terracotta ph:shield-check-fill icon and '256-bit SSL · PCI DSS' in 12.5px font-600.

A main at max-w-[1180px], py ~12-16, holding a grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_380px] gap-8 lg:gap-12 items-start: left column is the form (two stacked cards), right column is the sticky order-summary aside.

A rounded-2xl sandlt card with a #e6dcc9 border and shadow-soft, padding 6-8. Header: a 32px round terra/10 tile with a terracotta bold '1', and an h2 'Billing details' (18px font-700). Body: a 2-column gap-4 grid of labeled fields, where Email, Address line and Country span both columns: First name / Last name (2-up), Email address (full), Address line (full), City / Postal code (2-up), and a Country / region custom select (full) with an appearance-none field and a ph:caret-down-bold chevron pinned right. Each field has a .lbl label (0.78rem font-600 #5a5040) above a .field input.

A rounded-2xl sandlt card with a #e6dcc9 border and shadow-soft, padding 6-8. Header row justify-between: left = a 32px round terra/10 tile with terracotta bold '2' + an h2 'Payment method' (18px font-700); right (sm+) = the logos:visa, logos:mastercard, logos:amex brand marks at 26px. Then a 2-up segmented toggle (.seg) with 'Card' active (terracotta border, sandlt-tint fill #fbf3ee, terradk text, inset terra ring) showing ph:credit-card-fill, and 'PayPal' inactive showing the logos:paypal mark. Then the card fields: Card number (a .field with left padding for an inline ph:credit-card-bold icon, placeholder 4242 4242 4242 4242), Name on card, and a 2-up Expiry date (MM / YY) / CVC (label carries a ph:question hint icon). Below, a same-as-shipping checkbox: a 20px rounded-md filled-terra check box with a white ph:check-bold and the label 'Billing address is the same as shipping address' (13.5px ink).

prompts.partPt: Order summary card (the Topo Principal (Hero) component)
prompts.prompt: A right-column aside, lg:sticky top-24. A rounded-2xl dark ink (#2b251d) card with sand text and shadow-card, overflow-hidden. Header (border-b border-white/10): 'Order summary' (16px font-700 white) + a white/10 rounded-full '3 items' pill. Items block: three product rows, each = a 56px rounded-xl gradient swatch (warm clay / sage / terracotta gradients) holding a white ph:coffee/plant/bowl-food icon with a small terracotta quantity badge pinned top-right, then a title (14px font-600 white) + a sand/60 variant line, then a right-aligned price (14px font-600 white). A promo row: a translucent white/[.06] input (border white/15, placeholder sand/40, terra focus ring) + an outlined 'Apply' button. Totals block (border-t border-white/10): Subtotal / Shipping / Tax rows in sand/70 with sand/90 values, then a bordered Total row with a 22px font-800 white amount. Pay block: a full-width terradk (#a64f30) button, rounded-xl, py-3.5, white 15px font-700, shadow-btn, hover terraxd, with a ph:lock-key-fill icon and 'Pay $139.00'; below it a centered 12px sand/70 reassurance line with a ph:shield-check-fill icon. Below the card: a centered trust row 'Free returns' (ph:truck-fill) and 'Carbon neutral' (ph:leaf-fill) in terracotta + inkmut.

A slim footer on sandlt with a top hairline (border #e0d6c2). max-w-[1180px] row, py-8, stacks on mobile and goes side-by-side on sm+: left = a 28px terracotta tile with ph:diamonds-four-fill + the 'Atelier'+'Sand' wordmark (14px font-700); center = '© 2026 AtelierSand. Handmade goods, shipped with care.' (12.5px inkmut); right = ph:instagram-logo-fill and ph:pinterest-logo-fill social icons.

special_ui_components.prompt: A white input, width 100%, 1px border #e0d6c2, color ink #2b251d, border-radius 12px, padding 0.72rem 0.95rem, font-size 0.95rem; placeholder #7c715d. On :focus it removes the outline, sets border-color terra #c4633f, and adds a 4px ring box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(196,99,63,.14); transitions border-color/box-shadow/background ~0.18s. Paired with a .lbl label (0.78rem font-600 #5a5040, slight letter-spacing). Variants: a pl-11 field with an inline left ph:credit-card-bold icon, and an appearance-none select with a pinned ph:caret-down-bold chevron.

A 2-up grid of segment buttons. Each .seg is a centered flex with a 0.5rem gap, 1px border #e0d6c2, white background, border-radius 12px, padding 0.7rem, font-600 0.86rem inkmut, cursor pointer, ~0.18s all transition. The active segment (.seg.active) gets border-color terra #c4633f, background #fbf3ee, color terradk #a64f30, and an inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(196,99,63,.35) ring. Each holds an iconify icon (ph:credit-card-fill for Card, logos:paypal for PayPal) + a label.
A section header pattern: a 32px round terra/10 tile holding a terracotta bold step number (1, 2) followed by an 18px font-700 tracking-tight heading. Used to label the Billing and Payment cards.

On the dark ink summary card: a flex row, gap-4, items-center = a 56px shrink-0 rounded-xl gradient swatch (bg-gradient-to-br, warm two-stop gradients like #caa37e->#a87a52 / #8f9c7a->#5f6e4d / #c98a63->#a3613c) centering a white/90 product icon, with a 20px terracotta quantity badge pinned -top -right; then a min-w-0 flex-1 block with a truncating 14px font-600 white title + a 12.5px sand/60 variant subtitle; then a right 14px font-600 white price.

A pre-checked checkbox affordance: a 20px rounded-md box with border terra and a filled terra background centering a 13px white ph:check-bold, set inline before a 13.5px ink label, inside a cursor-pointer select-none label row.

A rounded-full white/70 pill (border #e0d6c2, shadow-soft) with a terracotta ph:shield-check-fill icon + '256-bit SSL · PCI DSS' for the hero; and a centered trust row under the summary card pairing ph:truck-fill 'Free returns' and ph:leaf-fill 'Carbon neutral' in terracotta-iconed inkmut text.

structured.special_notes: Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*) plus brand logos (logos:visa, logos:mastercard, logos:amex, logos:paypal) loaded from the iconify CDN. Tailwind is configured via CDN with custom named colors sand #efe7d8, sandlt #f6f1e7, sanddk #e6dcc9, terra #c4633f, terradk #a64f30, terraxd #8a4127, ink #2b251d, inkmut #6b6253, plus named shadows card/soft/btn, and Inter as the sans family. AA-contrast-fixed: the Pay button intentionally uses the darker terradk #a64f30 (escalating to terraxd #8a4127 on hover) so white button text clears WCAG AA, rather than the lighter terra #c4633f used for icons and accents. The page is one static frame; field focus rings, the segment-active styling and the Pay-button hover only animate live (the Card segment is shown in its active state). The 'AtelierSand' brand and product line are illustrative placeholders for a generic checkout.
